paper_metadata.title: Effect of Long-Period Stacking Order Phase and α-Mg Phase on Strength and Ductility of Mg-Zn-Y Alloy

evidence.quote: Recently, Mg–Zn–Y alloy has been found to show a high tensile yield strength with a good elongation. The alloy has a long-period stacking order (LPSO) phase as the secondary phase in an α-Mg phase.
